researchThemes.title: Chalcogenide phase-change thin films
researchThemes.body: Deposition and characterization of chalcogenide phase-change materials, whose large, non-volatile change in refractive index between amorphous and crystalline phases is the basis for reconfigurable optics.

researchThemes.title: Multi-level states by optical pulse engineering
researchThemes.body: Shaping sub-nanosecond optical pulses to reach intermediate, partially crystallized states, so one film can store more than two optical levels.

researchThemes.title: Active metasurfaces
researchThemes.body: Design and optimization of phase-change metasurfaces for reconfigurable nanophotonic devices, including disorder-based statistical encoding of light.
